# Getting help with WISE

## Start with the guides

- [Installation and dependencies](../docs/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](../docs/FAQ.md)
- [Validation status and known limits](../docs/VALIDATION.md)
- [MCP connection setup](../Supergent--main/docs/PLUGINS.md)

## Choose the right channel

| Need | Where to go |
| --- | --- |
| Reproducible non-sensitive bug | [Bug report](https://github.com/qwzx4893-stack/WISE-Agent/issues/new?template=bug.yml) |
| Focused feature or compatibility request | [Feature request](https://github.com/qwzx4893-stack/WISE-Agent/issues/new?template=feature.yml) |
| Setup / usage question not answered in the docs | [Question](https://github.com/qwzx4893-stack/WISE-Agent/issues/new?template=question.yml) |
| Vulnerability or private-data exposure | Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md); do not disclose it publicly. |

Search existing issues first. Include the commit, OS/Python version, launch path, configured component and minimal reproduction. Distinguish an uninstalled runtime from a broken feature, and a catalog entry from an authenticated service.

Use synthetic input and redact logs/screenshots. Never post credentials, account cookies, private conversations, browser profiles or personal documents. There is no support SLA or guaranteed response time for this development preview.
